verdict: ROAS steady at 3.86x, but purchases are softening and need attention.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $5,740 in revenue on $1,485 in spend — a solid 3.86x return — but purchase volume is declining, down 28.57% in the most recent week versus the prior week. The bulk of budget is concentrated in a single campaign, and early signs point to creative fatigue as the likely driver of erratic daily revenue. Google Business Profile engagement also dropped sharply this past week, reducing local-intent signals that would normally support overall demand. Ad creative is being refreshed this week, and overdue funnel and attribution work is being resolved to give paid campaigns a cleaner read going forward. October's milestones — including expanded Meta scaling and a site restyle — are on track to add more surface area before month-end.
